notes: Gap-closure alignment car 2 (task 2 gap-closure D5-D7): MCP client, sub-agent delegation, execute_code folding. Frontend untouched (owner freeze). (1) D5 MCP client (mycore/mcp.py, stdlib only): JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio (newline-delimited, daemon reader thread routes responses by id, stderr drained into a bounded ring so a chatty server cannot deadlock; dead-server reason carries exit code + stderr tail) and HTTP Streamable single-shot POST (application/json or text/event-stream response parsed, Mcp-Session-Id captured and replayed); initialize handshake + notifications/initialized + tools/list with <=5 pages; per-server allow/deny fnmatch filters and sanitized registration as mcp_<server>_<tool> (<=64 chars, collisions skipped); config precedence env MYCORE_MCP > settings mycore.mcp > off (empty = zero behavior change), JSON array <=4 servers <=4000 chars, exact parser reason surfaced by the settings validator; credentials are env SLOT names only ($SLOT resolved at connect time, a missing slot fails that server honestly naming the slot, never a value); fail-soft attach: bad config or an unreachable server becomes an honest SKIPPED note on registry.mcp_notes + an MCP service-log event, and the 11 core tools always register. Trust model documented plainly: allowed-roots does not apply to remote tools, filters bound visibility, not a sandbox. (2) D6 sub-agent delegation (new delegate tool + mycore/subagent.py): 1-3 tasks per call run in parallel threads (ThreadPoolExecutor <=3) through the same loop; each sub-agent gets a fresh two-message transcript (parent conversation never enters, its transcript never returns) and a read-only default tool set (read_file/grep/glob/http_fetch/skill_route) with write tools granted only when named explicitly; delegate and execute_code can never be granted (recursion guard); loop.run_turn binds the active turn's chat + budget into the registry so the sub-agent reuses the same model connection and never holds credentials; <=12 iterations and 6000-char result cap per task; one sub-agent's model error becomes an honest [i/N - model_error] block while siblings keep running; checkpoint id allocation and the cron tool are serialized (threading locks) so parallel writes cannot corrupt shared state. (3) D7 execute_code (new tool + mycore/execute_code.py), exactly one of two shapes: steps = up to 8 {name, args} tool calls dispatched in order against the same registry with every result folded into one labelled report ([i/N name] ok|ERROR, 2500-char per-step preview, nested execute_code/delegate refused up front, a failed step stays honest and later steps still run) - N model round trips collapse into one; code = Python source executed once in a child process (python -m mycore.execute_code --child) with a helper API read/grep/glob/write/edit/run/fetch wired to the same registry implementations, so allowed-roots are enforced and write/edit take pre-write checkpoints through the threaded state_dir; timeout 1-120s (default 120), 30000-char source cap, run_bash-style exit/stderr reporting, honest 'ERROR: code timed out after Ns'; trust model documented without sandbox claims (raw Python equals what run_bash already allows). (4) Settings/console: new mycore.mcp key (single line, <=4000 chars, JSON grammar validated with the parser's exact reason) in MYCORE_KEYS + settings.example.json; web smoke adds five checks (63 -> 68). (5) Docs: new docs/features/mcp.md, subagents.md, execute_code.md; PRODUCT_HANDOFF gains three feature rows, the module inventory is now 17 modules ~4.3k LOC (subagent.py + execute_code.py + mcp.py); mycore README documents the 11 core tools; competitive doc line refs re-anchored after the inserts. Verified gates: mycore 511/511 (was 438), web smoke 68/68 (was 63), router 30/30, memory 58/58, setup wizard 80/80, srclint 0 (locale packs en/zh 210 keys), doctor 9 active + 20 SKIP 0F/0W on a clean tree, publish READY(0), run_service --check rc=0, boot status 6 green.
